title: Chapter 615
paragraphs: Chapter 615
Episode 159. The Fighter King Tournament (2)
Even after unleashing the ultimate sword technique, he didn't immediately collapse as before.
The realization gained from crossing the line between life and death several times in the Sword Emperor's War and the sense gained from the divine integration with Ban resulted in Jin's growth.
He defeated the twelve fighter kings of the Emperor's Clan in one breath, and he didn't even use the newly learned ultimate sword technique.
However, Jin was not satisfied at all. Having experienced a realm close to the end of martial arts, it was difficult to feel a great achievement even when holding it.
Even after the first match of the Fighter King Tournament ended, Jin continued to look blank as if his soul was somewhere else.
The only time his eyes became clear was when the other fighters were fighting. At that time, Jin was focused on analysis.
Instead, after the match, he wandered aimlessly around Lafrarosa like a ghost with a blank look in his eyes.
"I'm worried if Jin is really going to lose his mind at this rate."
Pong! Tantel opened a bottle of jewel wine and sat next to Jin.
Jin was looking at the sky, sitting on the tower near the divine battle.
"Oh, Brother Tantel. You're here?"
"You didn't know I was here?"
"But what did you just say?"
"Oh, come on. Why are you like this? Explain."
It was a dilemma.
Also, it was a dilemma of abundance. The sensation of the divine battle made him feel his martial arts were insignificant.
"You're too full."
Tantel, who heard the story, shook his head with a sigh.

"Considering your age, you're just a little kid. But just a few days ago, you defeated a fighter king of the Emperor's Clan. Although the twelve fighter brothers are admittedly the weakest among them, he is clearly a fighter king."
The fact that Jin defeated Teto meant he had qualified to become a fighter king of the Emperor's Clan.
"I know that too."
Jin knew better than anyone.
But this training was the last opportunity before the inevitable war between the great powers. The stronger Jin became, the more anxious he felt.
He was worried about whether he could protect his comrades and his clan from the enemies when he returned.
Despite the achievements and power he has attained for his age, as Tantel said, his enemies were clearly larger than him.
If he could rescue his brothers in a moment, he could change the situation, but he didn't know when that would happen.
"Be careful if you know, Brother Jin. Read the atmosphere."
"Atmosphere?"
"Don't you feel the jealousy?"
"My brothers are jealous of me?"
"Well, why wouldn't they?"
Jin had received all kinds of privileges in Lafrarosa. He had already mastered the Emperor's Sword and received a blood transfusion from the Divine Battle even before becoming a brother.

"Of course, since Brother Jin has become our brother, all the achievements he has made are our pride. However, other brothers are also humans. Brother Teto trained for over a hundred years to become a fighter king, and there are many brothers who worked harder but ultimately couldn't become fighter kings."
It was a problem he hadn't thought of.

After being recognized as a brother, Jin had always been loved by the Emperor's Clan. The brothers always helped Jin first, were eager to reap the achievements he made, and were proud as if it was a blessing in their lives whenever they were summoned by the Black Call.
It was hard for Jin to imagine that those brothers would now be jealous.
"...I feel sorry for my brothers."
"Well, you don't need to feel sorry for everyone. There are many brothers who are proud, not jealous. I'm one of them."
Tantel handed him a bottle of jewel wine, and as he drank it, he felt a chill in his stomach.

"This Fighter King Tournament is the only opportunity for the brothers to express such skepticism and jealousy. Although it takes the form of a game with a rule of no killing, all the participating brothers are really putting their lives and hearts into it."
Listening to Tantel's words, Jin's face became hot and his chest tightened.
He was ashamed.

"So, you should also focus more and fight. When the Fighter King Tournament is over, regardless of the result and process, the brothers will certainly cherish Brother Jin as before... but never forget that all the brothers are also human. If there is even a little resentment left, it will fester someday."
Jin looked at Tantel.
Suddenly, he remembered the appearance of the fighter kings who had a predatory energy toward him after the battle with Teto ended.
"Thank you, Brother Tantel. Thanks to you, my mind has been cleared. But what's that paper?"
"This is nothing. Nothing, okay?"
Jin quickly grabbed Tantel's wrist as he hurriedly tried to hide the paper. This is what was written on the paper:
7th Tournament
Hell Great Sword King, Brother Garmund: Successor of the Whirlwind, Brother Jin
Odds 1.5 : 7
Who will be the winner!
"…Gambling?"
"It's just simple entertainment. It's done with jewel wine. It's a secret from the Divine Battle Brothers!"
Come to think of it, it seemed like Tantel had been carrying around a lot of jewel wine recently.
Tantel had bet on Jin in the first tournament.
"You can't really think the Divine Battle Brothers wouldn't know."
"Anyway, you have to win, Brother Jin! I bet all my jewel wine, if you win this time, you won't have to worry about alcohol for the rest of your life!"
Jin chuckled as he watched Tantel disappear hurriedly as if to escape.
The next day, the heavens were once again enveloped in a dark thunderstorm.
"We will begin the 7th tournament."
Jin and Garmund.
As the two stood facing each other, the thunderstorm lessened.
Jin had assumed that Garmund had about mid-tier skills among the Emperor's Clan fighters.
'He could be lower than that, but he's definitely different from Brother Teto.'
Normally, he couldn't win.

But Garmund was not in perfect condition now. Unlike Jin, who had rested ever since his battle with Teto, Garmund had fought fiercely against ordinary fighters who had challenged him in a group that morning.
He didn't have any major injuries, but he looked a little tired.
"Do you take me lightly, Brother Garmund?"
"Think as you wish. After all, the result is decided."
Garmund didn't show his usual hearty demeanor at all. He was full of resolute determination to crush his opponent.
Whoosh!
As soon as Jin stepped back, Garmund's great sword fell in front of him. As he blocked it, a shattering shock passed through his body along the blade.
And then, without realizing it, Jin used Aura to scatter that shock outside, and Garmund had no choice but to narrow his brow.
'That's the feeling!'
The sense of a divine warrior.
It was a difficult feat for the previous Jin to so simply scatter the shock that should have led to internal damage.
This is when the training to awaken Ban's sense began to really shine.
Not only that, but he also vividly recalled the memory of blocking Garmund's sword in the state of divine warrior fusion during the opening match.
'Brother Garmund is slow.'

Of course, this is relative. He possessed a monstrous strength that allowed him to swing a great sword that could easily surpass the weight of several generals like a dagger, and left afterimages whenever he properly executed his swordsmanship, but he could never be considered agile compared to other warriors.

Instead, Garmund replaced the gaps created by his slower speed with destructive power in battles against opponents of similar level. Spreading explosive thunder energy and aura in every gap created by the lack of speed was Garmund's way.
'If I exploit that part, I can at least have an advantage in one aspect over Brother Garmund.'
The exploitation was already over in the first offensive and defensive battle. It's about penetrating while scattering the shock transferred to the body to the outside.
As soon as Jin put that into action, Garmund had no choice but to respond urgently. An unexpected event occurred as soon as the battle began.

'Ha! Having tasted the sense of the divine warrior brothers, you say you've already developed your body technique to this extent? I guess it wasn't about accepting the challenge of the ordinary fighters this morning.'
Of course, Garmund didn't show confusion or panic. He skillfully pushed away Jin, who had penetrated his weakness, and devised a new tactic.
'I need to fight quickly. I'll end it in one go.'
Garmund expected Jin to unfold his Emperor's World Sword. Jin was doing well in penetrating and dispersing the shock, but he was not performing beyond that.
Therefore, a decisive blow was needed, and a sword with that destructive power had to be unfolded.
The Emperor's World Sword, Yeophwa, or the ultimate sword technique.
As far as Garmund knew, these three were the strongest swords Jin had.
'Yeophwa cannot fully demonstrate its power due to the absence of Tes, and Brother Jin would want to keep the ultimate sword technique as a hidden card if possible.'
The only thing left was the Emperor's World Sword.
'You must have gained confidence. You directly experienced Brother Teto not being able to use his hand properly.'
Garmund was confident that he could confront and shatter the head of the Emperor's World Sword that Jin currently had.
No, not just confidence, but certainty. The divine warrior's ultimate technique he possessed certainly surpassed the power of Jin's one Emperor's World Sword.
As expected, thunder energy was gathering in Jin's heart.
'Now, when Brother Jin unfolds the Emperor's World Sword, I have to shatter it with the divine warrior's ultimate technique in one go and cause a backlash....'
Garmund was looking for such an opportunity.
Even as the offensive and defensive battle continued for over 30 minutes, the thunder energy gathered in Jin's heart showed no signs of being replaced by aura.
"Ho, you knew all my plans?"
At Garmund's belated realization, Jin smiled.
"There would be no one who can't read Brother Garmund's thoughts. It's always written all over your face."
"Then I have no choice. I have to make the first move!"
Even if he had his move read, it wouldn't be a problem. After all, his intention to induce a backlash and end it was merely a consideration to prevent Jin from getting hurt as much as possible.
Crackle-!
Garmund's energy began to gather in one point.
At a glance, the energy that could knock down Jin with one swing and still remain was wrapping around the great sword.
"You can't handle this sword anyway."
However, regrettably, there was one more move that Garmund didn't calculate.
Garmund didn't notice Jin, who increased his speed even more and dug into the angle just before unfolding his technique.
He hadn't expected that Jin's body technique, which had so far offset his destructive power, and his quick swordsmanship, could get even faster there.
'Could you move faster than that!? While piercing through my energy...!'
He felt the tip of Siegmund's sword touch the back of his neck.
"It's over, Brother Garmund."
Garmund shrugged his shoulders and dissipated the energy gathered in his great sword.
"Damn, I didn't know I would lose so emptily."
[What are you going to do if you lose to that sly guy again? You guys, you weren't this pushy when you were pressing me!]
Ringling intervened, and Ban paused the battle and announced Jin's victory in a quiet voice.
'If Brother Garmund had thought a little deeper, he would have definitely lost. Fortunately, I didn't expect to win this way again after Brother Teto...'
The moment Jin thought that far.
One of the watching Monarchs screamed.
"Damn it! You're all messing around. Twelve Kings, Eight Kings Brothers. Can you still call yourselves the kings of the great Monarch Clan?"
